quotes.text:
Very much this. Complain to the ombudsman and highlight how their automated process stopped you being able to eat. You can likely get compensation back.

I realise it's little help, but also give them a 1-star review on google play – https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.revolut.revolut – and highlight this. Looks like supportdroid tends to get back fairly quickly...
quotes.story_title: Tell HN: Revolut suspended my account for no reason
